name: d4-mfe-poc
description: Workspace runner for the D4 Insight micro-frontend POC (4 standalone sibling apps)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n design-system,finance,recruitment,parent -c yellow,blue,magenta,green "npm run dev --prefix d4-design-system" "npm run start --prefix d4-finance" "npm run start --prefix d4-recruitment" "npm run start --prefix d4-parent"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix d4-design-system && npm install --prefix d4-parent && npm install --prefix d4-finance && npm install --prefix d4-recruitment
